name: job-compliance-agent
description: Monorepo for the job compliance audit agent.

scripts.build: npm run build:packages && npm run build --workspace @job-compliance/api && npm run build --workspace @job-compliance/web && npm run build --workspace @job-compliance/browser-extension
scripts.build:packages: npm run build --workspace @job-compliance/shared && npm run build --workspace @job-compliance/core && npm run build --workspace @job-compliance/database
scripts.check: npm run lint && npm test && npm run build && npm run check:i18n
scripts.dev: npm run dev:banner && npm run build:packages && concurrently --kill-others-on-fail --names API,WEB --prefix-colors blue,magenta "npm run dev:api:watch" "npm run dev:web:watch"
scripts.dev:api: npm run build:packages && npm run dev --workspace @job-compliance/api
scripts.dev:web: npm run build:packages && npm run dev --workspace @job-compliance/web
scripts.typecheck: npm run build:packages && npm run typecheck --workspace @job-compliance/api && npm run typecheck --workspace @job-compliance/web && npm run typecheck --workspace @job-compliance/browser-extension
